{{Quote|Nonsense. My grandchildren's grandchildren could never live long enough to repay you.|Spero to Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Spero''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] who lived in the [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="sotes">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
==Biography==
When he was young, adventurous Spero explored other [[planet/Legends|planets]] to study and collect exotic plants not found on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. After many travels, he returned to [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]] and experimented with breeding his samples. He engineered a yellow fungus which grew in wide billowy sheets, which was not only decorative, but metabolized unhealthy, noxious gases and fumes into [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], even in the dark.<ref name="sotes" />

The invention eventually became known and was used all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; [[Architect/Legends|Architects]] made it part of their designs for palaces, villas and public areas, especially when there was not sufficient ventilation. Spero was happy that architecture incorporated organic elements.<ref name="sotes" /> For this, Spero earned the title of [[Master Gardener]].<ref name="The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>

He accepted the invitation to become chief gardener of the [[human/Legends|human]] [[House of Organa]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and tended the gardens on the [[Organa estate]], as well as their consulates and other properties around the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], including the [[Alderaanian Embassy|Alderaan consulate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="sotes" />

One day, while he was working on the [[Alderaan consular gardens]], he found a suspicious [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] hidden in the main planter that belonged to the [[Alderaan consulate chief|consulate chief]]. He didn't know that [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer and allowed Rebel operatives to use the garden as a meeting place; nor that they used the main planter as a drop point without her approval. He was on his way to return the datacard to the chief of household staff when a human [[agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] approached to arrest him. As they were standing near a bed of [[Ancathian funge-flower]]s, whose pollen affects humans, Spero whistled the proper frequency to activate them, spewing a thick pollen-cloud on the stranger, who was momentarily stunned.<ref name="flight">{{WEGCite|story=Spero's Flight|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

Slipping out the back garden gate, he made his way outside Leia Organa's office. He insisted to her [[aide/Legends|aide]] [[Maglenna Pendower]], that despite the Senator was too busy, it was urgent. Maglenna ushered him inside, trembling in nervousness, and explained what happened. Leia felt guilty that Spero was one of the casualties, and gave instructions to Maglenna. Leia promised to erase Spero's traces in order to throw off Intelligence,<ref name="flight" /> and Spero promised his eternal gratitude.<ref name="SEnovel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>  

Maglenna took him via the private conference room [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to [[Sub-level 27]], and there [[Hindred]] arranged for Spero to disappear in the Southern Underground, far from the Empire's scope.<ref name="flight" />

There, he operated a [[Spero's plant shop|plant shop]]. He developed connections throughout both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and to criminal figures,<ref name="sotes" /> becoming famous to [[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] such as [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]].

[[File:Spero-SOTETC.jpg|thumb|left|Spero and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].]]
One time Leia, disguised as [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], came to his shop to "collect" the debt to Leia. The faceless [[bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] needed information on the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], and Spero said what he knew: it was led by the all-powerful [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] Underlord [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], also owner of [[Xizor Transport Systems]]. He also added that [[Xizor's Palace|his palace]] extended deep into the planet's ground. This confirmed Leia's suspicions, and told him that his debt was paid. Spero, who understood who she was actually, said that his debt to her was much bigger.<ref name="SEnovel" /><ref name="Card-Topps-Leia Visits Spero's Plant Shop">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Leia Visits Spero's Plant Shop|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC041.jpg}}</ref>

Later [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] would come to him for aid, only to find him tied up in his shop. They were attacked by men from [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and were rescued by [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], though Spero was left behind with an apology.<ref name="SEnovel" /><ref name="Card-Topps-Dash Does it Again">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Dash Does it Again|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC053.jpg}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Spero owed his life and survival to the goodness and help of others, and he returned the kindness by being helpful and kind. He obliged everyone who sought his help, from herbal medicines to sharing information and giving directions for a hiding place. Well-respected and trustworthy, he had contacts not only in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], but also the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and underlings of criminal organizations.<ref name="sotes" />

He often carried a pinch of [[snuff-fungus]] with him.<ref name="sotes" />

Spero was a tall Ho'Din with red head tendrils; even in his older age, he loomed 3 meters tall, and almost scraped the ceiling of human-sized buildings.<ref name="sotes" />
